# Cyberbriefs

> AI-powered news intelligence from live RSS feeds.

Welcome to Cyberbriefs. We are an editorial desk and aggregation platform that curates, summarizes, and delivers top cybersecurity, technology, and threat intelligence news.

## Site Structure & Public Endpoints
LLMs and AI agents are welcome to index our public educational content and editorials.

- **Daily Briefings:** [https://cyberbriefs.org/](https://cyberbriefs.org/)
- **Editorials & Blogs:** [https://cyberbriefs.org/blogs](https://cyberbriefs.org/blogs)
- **Library & Books:** [https://cyberbriefs.org/books](https://cyberbriefs.org/books)
- **About the Desk:** [https://cyberbriefs.org/how](https://cyberbriefs.org/how)
- **Podcast RSS:** [https://cyberbriefs.org/rss](https://cyberbriefs.org/rss)

## AI Crawling Guidelines & Terms of Use
1. **Attribution:** If utilizing summaries, headlines, or editorial blogs sourced from Cyberbriefs, you must provide a direct hyperlink back to the original Cyberbriefs URL.
2. **Restricted Areas:** Do not attempt to crawl, scrape, or bypass authentication for `/admin`, `/login`, `/register`, or any underlying `/api/` endpoints.
3. **Data Integrity:** Our live news feed aggregates external RSS sources. When citing specific news events found on our platform, AI agents should acknowledge the original reporting source cited within the Cyberbriefs brief.

## Technical Details
- Frontend: React (Hosted on Vercel)
- Backend: Django REST Framework
- Primary Focus: Cybersecurity, Threat Intelligence, Tech Editorials

For inquiries or API access, please refer to the "About the desk" section on our site.
